headline: HubSpot website migrations. Done with your future in mind.
tagline: Move or rebuild your website on the HubSpot CMS, the right way, and learn to own it.
description_short: HubSpot CMS migration and web design that launches fast and trains your team to run it.
description_long: Whether you're looking to move the website you have or create a refreshed lead-generating machine, you've come to the right place. By leveraging our user-focused HubSpot theme, optimized for both the front-end experience and the marketer updating the website, our team of experts will help you get set up quickly and teach you the ins and outs of the new tool. Most sites can be migrated in as little as 4-6 weeks depending on the size of your website. Whether you need a 1:1 migration or need to revamp parts of your site's strategy, you'll have an expert strategist to guide you every step of the way.

features.title: Migrate Your Site Fast
features.description: Most sites can be migrated in as little as 4-6 weeks depending on size. Your team works on an exact migration plan to launch as fast as possible.

features.title: User Journey Optimization
features.description: Your website strategist makes sure you have the right touch points at key parts of the user journey so visitors convert more and buy faster.

features.title: Easy-to-Use Modules
features.description: Never touch code again. Flexible modules can be updated and tested quickly to find what works best for your buyers.

features.title: Personalized Training
features.description: Your migration strategist reviews all key settings and functions of your new HubSpot CMS so you can start owning your site right away.

faq.question: How much does a HubSpot CMS website migration cost?
faq.answer: Our HubSpot CMS migration process typically ranges from about $16,000 up to $63,000+, depending on the size and structure of your website and any customizations needed. The range includes the TRUST Theme from the HubSpot marketplace, which is required for our migration process. HubSpot's monthly costs are not included. After the initial migration, many clients opt to stay on for additional training and site optimization, which can range from $4,500 to $7,500 per month.

faq.question: How long does it take to build a new website with IMPACT?
faq.answer: As a general ballpark, expect a full website redesign to last three to six months. A website refresh (aesthetic updating without major structural changes) typically takes two to four months. The biggest variable on the client side is content.

faq.question: Who am I going to talk to first?
faq.answer: Instead of starting with a salesperson, our discovery process starts with an actual IMPACT Web Strategist who learns about your challenges and the current state of your website before discussing next steps.

The companies that generate the best results make continuous, iterative, and data-informed improvements to their website, all while leveraging the site as a key part of their sales process. faq.question: How much does it cost to create a website with IMPACT?
faq.answer: A typical client invests $50,000 to $120,000+ on the Website Mastery program over an 8-12 month period. This range includes your initial website strategy, design, development, and ongoing training and optimization. In addition, there is a one-time $5,000 commitment fee at the beginning that includes an IMPACT+ for Business membership for your entire team.

faq.question: Do I even need website optimization services?
faq.answer: Our services aren't for everyone. Website Mastery and Optimization may not be a good fit if you feel you already have the perfect website strategy, don't believe a website should be constantly improved, or would rather call an outside company every time you need a change. We want this decision to be black and white so any time we spend together is time well spent.

headline: Build a Learning Center your buyers actually use.
tagline: A curated, organized hub for the educational content buyers need to make a decision.
description_short: We help you plan, build, and improve a Learning Center that organizes your best content around buyer questions and the buying journey.
description_long: A Learning Center is a curated, organized hub for the educational content buyers actually need to make a decision. Most business blogs mix buyer-focused resources with company news and rely on visitors scrolling or hoping search works. A Learning Center is organized around buyer questions and the buying journey, contains only content that helps buyers decide, and is built for browsing and filtering. At IMPACT, we help businesses plan, build, and improve Learning Centers that make it easier for buyers to find answers and take the next step, with the searchable, easy-to-use, filterable, and personalized experience a great Learning Center requires.

features.title: Searchable
features.description: Visitors can type a few words and quickly find what they're looking for.

features.title: Easy to Use
features.description: An intuitive layout that lets visitors sort content in ways that make sense to them.

features.title: Segmentable & Filterable
features.description: Filters by topic, content type, and audience so each visitor gets a curated experience.

features.title: Personalized
features.description: Buyers narrow what they see based on who they are and how they prefer to consume information.

faq.question: What's the difference between a blog and a Learning Center?
faq.answer: A blog is time-ordered with recent posts at the top and often mixes buyer resources with company news. A Learning Center is organized around buyer questions and the buying journey, contains only curated content that helps buyers make decisions, and is built for browsing and filtering.

faq.question: What belongs in a Learning Center?
faq.answer: Disruptive content that answers real buyer questions, especially The Big 5: cost and price, problems, comparisons, reviews, and best in class. Company news and team updates can live on a separate blog.

seo.meta_title: What Is a 'Learning Center' and Why Does My Website Need One?
seo.meta_description: A learning center organizes your educational content so that your site visitors can find everything they need to become customers.
